scope: Core and actual VS Code development/production installation checks including retained project check baselines. Test-only follow-ups synchronize manifest events and editor analysis; runtime files remain from c602693. Command exits are not semantic equivalence, model quality, scientific validity or application-wide correctness.

jobs.name: verify (windows-latest)
